inputs.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 100.93 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.4 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. Gaia DR2 plus Lowell inversion; publication table gives 520 Lowell and 26 Gaia points. The two published poles remain; select model 4072 as a reproducible representative, without rejecting model 4073. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.
